title: Operation Theatre Surgical Safety Protocol
content:
SOP: Operation Theatre Surgical Safety Protocol (SOP-OT-001)
DEPARTMENT: Operation Theatre
VERSION: 4.1
ROLES: doctor, nurse, anesthetist
PURPOSE: Enforce Sign-In, Time-Out, and Sign-Out verification.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Operation Theatre Surgical Safety Protocol in full compliance with Operation Theatre hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Operation Theatre Surgical Safety Protocol in full compliance with Operation Theatre hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Operation Theatre Surgical Safety Protocol in full compliance with Operation Theatre hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Operation Theatre Surgical Safety Protocol in full compliance with Operation Theatre hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Operation Theatre Surgical Safety Protocol in full compliance with Operation Theatre hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 6: Execute phase 6 of Operation Theatre Surgical Safety Protocol in full compliance with Operation Theatre hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 7: Execute phase 7 of Operation Theatre Surgical Safety Protocol in full compliance with Operation Theatre hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Operation Theatre.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-OT-001 Operation Theatre Surgical Safety Protocol v4.1, Section 4
